messages:
Aisha (AE): Heads-up: Ripcord asking for a 3-week POC to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. Key requirements: streaming parity, function-calls, prompt/response parity, cost impact, and security questionnaire. Need SE + SRE.

Ben (SE): I can run the POC. Need ~100 sanitized request examples (stream frames + function calls) and their acceptance criteria (semantic similarity threshold or human accept rate). Will build an adapter shim to normalize request/response shapes.

Dana (Presales): They stream line-delimited frames and rely on function-calling extensively. They'll send samples after NDA. Also asking about SAML, SCIM, and data residency.

Chao (SRE): Quick security note: Hosted covers IP allowlist and audit logs. Client cert auth or VPC peering requires Dedicated/Private. We'll need SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration notes. I'll prepare staging IPs once NDA is signed.

Ben (SE): Parity notes: map CompetitorX `passages` -> Redwood `messages`, convert function args, and rewrap Redwood streaming deltas into their chunk frames. Billing diff: CompetitorX historically billed response-only; Redwood bills prompt+completion. Recommend 48h side-by-side capture for accurate cost delta.

infra-bot: staging env created: ripcord-poc-01. Upload path: s3://redwood-pocs/ripcord-3498/ (restricted). Ephemeral keys issued.

LegalBot: NDA required before any logs or customer data are uploaded. Attach questionnaire after NDA; Legal will review DPA items.

Aisha (AE): Owners: Ben -> technical POC & eval harness; Chao -> infra & network; Dana -> questionnaire + SSO; Aisha -> NDA + customer coordination. Kickoff Monday.

Ben (SE): I'll push a smoke-run script and the shim prototype to S3 and start a 48h side-by-side once we have samples.

Chao (SRE): I'll provision two staging IPs for allowlist and schedule a peering window. If they require cert pinning, we'll escalate to Dedicated.

Dana (Presales): I'll compile FAQ answers for SAML/SCIM/retention and flag items that need Dedicated.

Aisha (AE): Thanks team. I'll send NDA and request the sanitized dataset. Post blockers here before kickoff.
